questions.prompt: Expand the sentence 'The musician played' by adding an emphatic, abrupt detail using punctuation for effect.
choices: The musician played—raw and unrestrained.

feedback.win: Hand won! Your dashes, colons, and semicolons did the work.
feedback.lose: The dealer takes this one. Remember: colon announces, semicolon connects, dash punctuates with force.
